about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Pollo in Potacchio (Marche Chicken with Rosemary, Wine and Tomato)
recipes.summary: A Marche braise of chicken pieces with rosemary, garlic, white wine and tomato, simple and fragrant.
steps: Brown the drumsticks in the oil in a wide pan for 10 minutes. Add the garlic and rosemary for 1 minute.
Pour in the wine and let it bubble for 3 minutes, then add the tomatoes, potato and 1 tsp salt.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C and the sauce is thick.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink juices. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pasta alla Norma (Sicilian Eggplant and Ricotta Pasta)
recipes.summary: Fried eggplant in tomato and basil sauce over pasta, finished with baked ricotta salata-style cheese.
steps: Fry the eggplant in the oil in two batches for 8 minutes each, until golden and soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and 1/2 tsp salt and simmer for 12 minutes, until thick.
Cook the pasta in salted water for 10 minutes, until al dente, drain and toss with the sauce and basil. Dollop with ricotta.
notes: Vegetarian. Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Parmigiana di Zucchine (Baked Zucchini with Tomato and Cheese)
recipes.summary: Layers of roasted zucchini, tomato sauce and cheese baked until bubbling, a lighter take on parmigiana.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the zucchini with the oil and 1/2 tsp salt and roast on trays for 20 minutes, until soft and golden.
Warm the passata with the garlic and 1/4 tsp salt for 5 minutes.
Layer sauce, zucchini, basil and hard cheese in a baking dish, finishing with mozzarella. Bake for 25 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
notes: Vegetarian. Contains milk. Fresh mozzarella is made with microbial rennet in many brands; check the label.

recipes.title: Torta Pasqualina (Ligurian Spinach and Ricotta Pie with Baked Eggs)
recipes.summary: A Ligurian pie of spinach and ricotta in crisp filo with whole eggs baked inside.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Wilt the spinach in a pan for 4 minutes, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with the ricotta, hard cheese, marjoram and 1/2 tsp salt.
Layer half the filo, brushing each sheet with butter, in a 24cm tin. Spread in the filling, make 5 wells and crack an egg into each.
Top with the remaining filo, brushing with butter. Bake for 40 minutes, until golden and the eggs are set.
notes: Food safety: eggs should be cooked until the whites are fully set. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Vegetarian. Contains egg, milk and gluten.

recipes.title: Polenta e Funghi (Soft Polenta with Garlic Mushrooms)
recipes.summary: Creamy polenta with garlic and thyme mushrooms and shaved cheese, a vegetarian northern Italian dinner.
steps: Whisk the polenta into 6 cups of simmering salted water. Cook on low for 25 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Cook the mushrooms in the oil in a hot pan for 8 minutes, until browned. Add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute.
Stir the butter and cheese into the polenta, top with mushrooms and parsley.
notes: Vegetarian. Contains milk. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Lentil Bolognese with Spaghetti (Vegan)
recipes.summary: A rich lentil and tomato ragu with carrot, celery and red wine, spooned over spaghetti.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste for 1 minute, then the wine.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and 2 cups water. Simmer for 30 minutes, until the lentils are tender and the sauce thick.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water for 10 minutes, drain and serve with the ragu.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Chicken Marengo (Napoleonic Chicken with Tomato, Mushrooms and Wine)
recipes.summary: A French and Italian classic of chicken braised with tomato, mushrooms and white wine.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 8 minutes a side, skin down first. Lift out.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the same pan for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, wine and tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer for 25 minutes, until it reaches 75°C. Scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink juices. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Flamiche (Picardy Leek and Cream Tart)
recipes.summary: A savoury Picardy tart of soft leek, cream and egg in a buttery crust, served with a green salad.
steps: Rub 100g butter into the flour with 1/2 tsp salt and add about 1/3 cup cold water to form a dough. Roll to fit a 24cm tart tin and press in.
Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Cook the leek in the remaining butter for 12 minutes, until soft. Blind bake the case 15 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, cream, cheese, nutmeg and 1/2 tsp salt. Fill the case with leek, pour over the custard and bake 30 minutes, until just set and golden.
notes: Food safety: eggs should be cooked until the whites are fully set. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Vegetarian. Contains egg, milk and gluten.

recipes.title: Pimientos Rellenos (Spanish Stuffed Capsicums in Tomato Sauce)
recipes.summary: Capsicums stuffed with beef, rice and onion and baked in a smoky tomato sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Cut the tops off the capsicums and remove the seeds.
Cook the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, then mix with the mince, rice, paprika and 1/2 tsp salt. Fill the capsicums.
Stand in a dish with the passata and 1/2 cup water. Cover and bake for 45 minutes, until the filling reaches 75°C and the capsicums are soft.
notes: Food safety: mince must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Patatas a la Riojana (Spanish Potato and Chorizo Stew)
recipes.summary: A Riojan peasant stew of potato and chorizo in a smoky paprika broth.

items: 1kg potato, peeled and torn into chunks

steps: Cook the chorizo in a pot for 5 minutes. Add the onion, capsicum and garlic and cook for 6 minutes.
Stir in the paprika and potato, then the stock and bay leaves. Simmer for 25 minutes, until the potato is tender and the broth thickened by its starch.
Season with salt and serve.
notes: Food safety: sausage and cured meats must be steaming hot, reaching at least 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Garbanzos con Espinacas (Andalusian Chickpeas with Spinach and Cumin)
recipes.summary: A Seville tapas classic made a full dinner: chickpeas and spinach in a garlicky cumin and paprika sauce.
steps: Fry the bread and garlic in the oil for 3 minutes, until golden. Blitz with the cumin, paprika, vinegar and 1/2 cup water to a paste.
Heat the paste in a pan, add the chickpeas and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 8 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the spinach for 3 minutes, until wilted. Season with salt.
notes: Vegan. Contains gluten.

recipes.title: Arroz con Costillas (Spanish Rice with Pork Ribs and Paprika)
recipes.summary: Pork rib pieces simmered with rice, tomato and smoked paprika, a hearty Spanish one-pan dinner.
steps: Brown the ribs in the oil for 10 minutes. Lift out. Cook the onion and capsicum for 6 minutes with the garlic, paprika and tomato.
Return the ribs, add the stock and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, until nearly tender.
Stir in the rice, season with salt and simmer uncovered for 18 minutes, until the rice is tender and the pork cooked through. Rest for 5 minutes.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C in the centre, with clear juices, and rest before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Soupa Avgolemono (Greek Chicken, Rice and Lemon Soup)
recipes.summary: A silky Greek soup of chicken and rice thickened with egg and lemon.
steps: Simmer the chicken, stock and carrot for 15 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C. Lift out and shred.
Add the rice and cook for 12 minutes, until tender.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice and a ladle of hot broth, then stir back into the pot off the heat with the chicken and dill. Warm gently without boiling.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink juices. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot. Cook the egg and lemon mixture gently until thickened; do not eat raw egg.
Contains egg. Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Hortopita (Greek Wild Greens and Feta Pie)
recipes.summary: A Greek filo pie packed with greens, herbs and feta, crisp outside and lush inside.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Cook the leek and spring onion in 1 tbsp oil for 6 minutes. Wilt the spinach for 4 minutes, squeeze dry and chop.
Mix the greens with the dill, crumbled feta, eggs and pepper.
Layer half the filo in a 24cm tin, brushing each sheet with oil. Add the filling, then top with the remaining filo, brushing again. Bake for 40 minutes, until deep golden.
notes: Food safety: eggs should be cooked until the whites are fully set. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Vegetarian. Contains egg, milk and gluten.

recipes.title: Khoresh Bademjan (Persian Lamb and Eggplant Stew)
recipes.summary: A tangy Persian lamb stew with fried eggplant, tomato and dried lime flavours.
steps: Fry the eggplant in 2 tbsp oil in batches for 10 minutes, until golden. Set aside.
Brown the lamb and onion in the remaining oil for 10 minutes. Stir in the turmeric, tomato paste, tomatoes, lemon juice and 1.5 cups water. Simmer, covered, for 1 hour 15 minutes, until tender.
Lay the eggplant on top and simmer 15 minutes. Cook the rice in salted water for 12 minutes and serve.
notes: Food safety: lamb pieces are safe once they reach at least 70°C and are tender. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Abgoosht (Persian Lamb and Chickpea Stew)
recipes.summary: A Persian lamb, chickpea and potato stew eaten as a broth with bread then a mash of the solids.
steps: Put the lamb, onion, chickpeas, tomato paste, turmeric and 1 tsp salt in a pot with 1.2L water. Bring to a boil, until scum rises, and skim.
Simmer, covered, for 1 hour 30 minutes, until the chickpeas and lamb are tender. Add the potato and cook for 30 minutes more.
Stir in the lemon juice. Serve the broth with bread, and mash the solids to eat alongside.
notes: Food safety: lamb pieces are safe once they reach at least 70°C and are tender. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free. Soaking is not counted in prep.

recipes.title: Koobideh (Persian Minced Lamb and Beef Kebabs with Saffron Rice)
recipes.summary: Flat skewers of spiced minced lamb and beef, grilled and served over saffron rice with grilled tomato.

items: 1 brown onion, grated and squeezed dry

steps: Knead the minces, onion, sumac and salt for 5 minutes until sticky. Mould around flat skewers.
Cook the rice in salted water for 12 minutes, drain and stir through the saffron steeped in 2 tbsp hot water and the butter.
Grill the kebabs and tomato halves on high for 10 minutes, turning, until the kebabs reach 75°C and are browned.
notes: Food safety: mince must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Hunter's Chicken (Bacon and Cheese Barbecue Chicken Bake)
recipes.summary: Chicken breast wrapped in bacon, brushed with a smoky barbecue glaze and baked under melted cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the potato with the oil and 1/2 tsp salt and roast for 35 minutes.
Wrap each breast in a rasher of bacon and place in a dish. Brush with half the sauce and bake for 20 minutes.
Add the remaining sauce and cheese and bake for 8 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C and the cheese is bubbling. Steam the beans for 5 minutes and serve.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink juices. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot. Bacon must be fully cooked.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Spinach Wellington
recipes.summary: A golden puff pastry Wellington packed with roasted mushrooms, spinach and herbs, a vegetarian roast for entertaining.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the mushrooms in the oil for 12 minutes, until all the liquid has evaporated. Add the garlic, thyme and spinach for 3 minutes. Stir in the breadcrumbs and 1/2 tsp salt. Cool.
Overlap the pastry sheets, pile the filling in a log, fold the pastry over and seal. Place seam-down on a tray and brush with the egg.
Bake for 35 minutes, until deep golden and puffed.
notes: Vegetarian if puff pastry is. Contains egg and gluten.

recipes.title: Semmelknodel with Creamy Mushroom Sauce
recipes.summary: Bavarian bread dumplings with a creamy mushroom and parsley sauce, a vegetarian dinner.
steps: Cook the onion in half the butter for 5 minutes. Mix with the bread, milk, eggs, parsley and 1 tsp salt and rest for 15 minutes. Shape into 8 balls.
Simmer the dumplings in salted water for 20 minutes, until firm and cooked through.
Cook the mushrooms in the remaining butter for 8 minutes, add the cream and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve over the dumplings.
notes: Food safety: eggs should be cooked until the whites are fully set. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Vegetarian. Contains egg, milk and gluten.

recipes.title: Toltott Paprika (Hungarian Stuffed Peppers in Tomato Sauce)
recipes.summary: Peppers stuffed with pork and rice and simmered in a sweet tomato sauce with paprika, served with sour cream.
steps: Cut the tops from the capsicums and remove the seeds. Mix the pork, rice, onion, half the paprika, egg and 1 tsp salt and fill the capsicums.
Stand them in a pot, pour in the passata, 1 cup water and the remaining paprika. Cover and simmer for 55 minutes, until the filling reaches 75°C and the rice is tender.
Serve with the sauce and a spoon of sour cream.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C in the centre, with clear juices, and rest before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot. Mince must be cooked through.
Contains egg and milk.

recipes.title: Biff Rydberg (Swedish Beef, Potato and Onion Hash with Egg Yolk)
recipes.summary: Swedish diced beef and potato fried crisp with onion, topped with a fried egg and pickles.
steps: Boil the potato for 5 minutes, drain and dry. Fry in the oil in a wide pan for 10 minutes, until crisp.
Add the butter, onion and beef and cook for 6 minutes, until the beef is browned and reaches 70°C. Add the mustard and 1/2 tsp salt.
Fry the eggs for 3 minutes, until the whites are set. Top each plate with an egg and pickles.
notes: Food safety: eggs should be cooked until the whites are fully set. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot. Beef pieces must be cooked through.
Contains egg and milk.

recipes.title: Boller i Karry (Norwegian Meatballs in Mild Curry Sauce)
recipes.summary: Pork and beef meatballs in a mild creamy curry sauce, a Norwegian family classic served with rice.
steps: Mix the minces, breadcrumbs, milk, egg, 1/2 the onion and 1 tsp salt and roll into 24 balls. Brown in half the butter for 8 minutes.

Melt the remaining butter, cook the remaining onion for 4 minutes, stir in the flour and curry powder, then whisk in the stock. Add the meatballs and simmer for 12 minutes, until the sauce is thick and the meatballs reach 75°C.
Cook the rice in salted water for 12 minutes and serve.
notes: Food safety: mince must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Contains milk, egg and gluten.

recipes.title: Kalamojakka (Finnish Salmon and Potato Soup with Dill and Cream)
recipes.summary: A gentle Finnish salmon and potato soup with leek, allspice and dill.
steps: Simmer the potato, leek, onion, allspice and stock for 15 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Add the salmon and simmer for 5 minutes, until opaque and flaking.
Stir in the cream and dill, season with salt and pepper and warm through without boiling.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when it turns opaque and flakes easily. Eat the same day or refrigerate within an hour and use within 24 hours. Contains fish and milk.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Boston Baked Beans with Smoked Sausage
recipes.summary: Slow-baked white beans in molasses and tomato with smoked sausage, an American pulses dinner served with bread.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Mix the beans, onion, molasses, tomato paste, mustard, vinegar, stock and 1/2 tsp salt in a casserole.
Tuck in the sausage. Cover and bake for 1 hour 30 minutes, uncovering for the last 30 minutes, until thick and glossy.
Rest for 10 minutes and serve with bread.
notes: Food safety: sausage and cured meats must be steaming hot, reaching at least 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Baked Stuffed Pumpkin with Rice, Mushrooms and Cheese
recipes.summary: A whole small pumpkin baked with a savoury filling of rice, mushrooms, spinach and cheese, a vegetarian showpiece.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Cut the top from the pumpkin, scoop out the seeds and rub the inside with a little oil and salt. Bake for 30 minutes.
Cook the onion, mushrooms and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes, add the spinach to wilt. Mix with the rice, thyme, half the cheese and 1/2 tsp salt.
Fill the pumpkin, top with the remaining cheese and bake for 40 minutes, until the flesh is tender and the top golden. Cut into wedges.
notes: Vegetarian. Contains milk. Gluten-free.
